text:
alex: quick one — we should create release/1.14 today. status on cutoff? who's owning branch creation?

mira: I'm oncall but can spin the branch if someone signs off changelog.

tyler: I can do the backport queue triage; prefer we only accept critical and regressions after cutoff.

alex: +1 on triage scope. changelog PRs need labels: changelog/major or changelog/minor. can we require changelog PRs merged before branch is cut?

sam: prefer a soft lock: only security/critical after cutoff, everything else goes to next release.

release-bot: release-tool:ci created release branch stub release/1.14 at commit abcdef1 (auto).

mira: thanks. I'll run the branch creation script:

```bash
./scripts/release/mkbranch.sh --version 1.14 --source main
git push origin release/1.14
```

tyler: once branch exists I'll open a triage spreadsheet and assign backport owners. I'll prioritize by impact: crash > data-loss > api-break > docs.

alex: For cherry-picks: require linked issue, green CI, and approval from owner. No manual edits to changelog on branch; do changelog PRs against main and backport if necessary.

sam: what's our fallback if a cherry-pick breaks CI during cut window? revert immediately and add to next cycle.

mira: adding small checklist for whoever cuts branch: 1) confirm changelog PRs, 2) bump version in build, 3) run quick smoke test, 4) tag owners.

alex: ping @tyler when branch pushed. I'll update release notes draft.

tyler: pinged. I'll populate triage doc and DM owners.

alex: thanks all. if no objections I'll mark release/1.14 created and send cutover nudge in #eng-releases in 30m. :shipit:
